title: Honda clinches 12th IndyCar manufacturers’ crown
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Before Alex Palou wrapped up the drivers’ title, Honda captured its 12th IndyCar Series manufacturers’ championship on Sunday at the Milwaukee Mile, with two races left to run.

title: After double dose of victory in Milwaukee, Pato O'Ward's name among legends
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: The list of IndyCar drivers who have won twice on the same day reads like a list of the greatest race drivers of all time: Mario Andretti, Al Unser, Bobby Unser, Dan Gurney, Johnny Rutherford and Rick Mears.

title: 'We're just cursed': David Malukas dealt another heartbreaking loss at Milwaukee
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Someday, Lady Luck will have to pay the piper and give David Malukas his first IndyCar victory.

title: Palou clinches fourth consecutive, fifth overall IndyCar title in Milwaukee
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Alex Palou entered Milwaukee as "Quattro," IndyCar’s reigning four-time champion with a remarkable streak of three titles in a row, and left as "Cinco," the newest five-time champ with a streak that now extends to four consecutive crowns and five in a span of six years.

title: Alex Palou is on pace to shatter IndyCar records like no driver has ever done
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Alex Palou is already one of the greatest IndyCar drivers of all time. In another decade, he might be looked at as the greatest the sport has ever seen.

title: Alex Palou clinches 5th IndyCar title; Pato O'Ward sweeps Milwaukee twin bill
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Pato O'Ward had a day for the record book -- something Alex Palou knows all about. While O'Ward won two IndyCar races in one day at the Milwaukee Mile, Palou did enough to clinch a historic IndyCar Series championship with one week to go Sunday in West Allis, Wis.

title: O’Ward makes it a Sunday sweep with IndyCar Race 1 win at Milwaukee
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: The Arrow McLaren driver made two visits to victory lane Sunday, winning both races in IndyCar's doubleheader at the Milwaukee Mile as Alex Palou secured his fifth championship title.

title: Pato O'Ward wins Milwaukee Mile 250 with postponed race still on tap
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Pato O'Ward claimed his second victory of the season Sunday by edging Scott McLaughlin at the Snap-on Milwaukee Mile 250 in West Allis, Wis. The native of Mexico is in a rare position to win two races in one day after Saturday's Snap-on Makers and Fixers 250 was interrupted by heavy rain and postponed to a Sunday finish.

title: Lundgaard scores timely oval breakthrough with Milwaukee podium
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Christian Lundgaard’s most impressive oval performance was delivered last year at the Milwaukee Mile, where he wheeled the No. 7 Chevy to sixth, and with another year of experience to draw from, the outgoing Arrow McLaren driver set a new career best with third in Sunday’s Race 2.

title: Fifth place at Milwaukee has Palou on the cusp of a fifth title
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: While it wasn’t enough to clinch his fifth IndyCar Series championship, he did extend the lead to a nearly insurmountable 97 points over Kyle Kirkwood, who finished sixth.

title: O’Ward blasts to victory in the first of IndyCar’s two Milwaukee races to finish
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Pato O’Ward started second and finished first in Sunday’s Snap-On Race 2 at the Milwaukee Mile, which was actually the first to be completed after the conclusion of Saturday's Race 1 was postponed until this evening.

title: Pato O'Ward wins Snap-On Milwaukee Mile 250; Alex Palou inches closer to fifth IndyCar title
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: O'Ward won Sunday's NTT IndyCar Series race at the Milwaukee Mile while leading another race at the same time.

title: Weather causes more changes to Sunday IndyCar schedule at Milwaukee Mile
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Morning rain and the need to dry the track led to a juggled start time of the IndyCar races set for Sunday at the Milwaukee Mile in West Allis, Wis. Pounding rain on Saturday forced the red flag to come out and delayed the completion of the Snap-on Makers and Fixers 250 with 160 laps remaining.

title: Milwaukee IndyCar Race 1 postponed again to 6pm ET
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Overnight rain and thunderstorms have undone the IndyCar Series’ plans to resume Saturday’s Snap-On Race 1 at the Milwaukee Mile this morning. Rain is expected to continue for a brief period before finishing for the day.

title: Rain delays in Milwaukee create two-race Sunday
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: An unrelenting rain system led to a red flag on lap 90 of the Snap-On Makers and Fixers 250 in Milwaukee Saturday, and the cars couldn't return to the track.

title: IndyCar's Race 1 at Milwaukee postponed, set to resume Sunday
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Due to inclement weather and difficulties drying the track, the red-flagged race was unable to continue Saturday night and has been postponed to 8 a.m. CT/9 a.m. ET on Sunday.

title: O’Ward leads IndyCar Race 1 in Milwaukee at red flag
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Light but persistent showers brought an halt to Saturday’s IndyCar Series race at the Milwaukee Mile, now set to resume Sunday morning.

title: McLaughlin, Palou split Milwaukee IndyCar poles, but only one will start from the front
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Engine penalties for Saturday's race move Arrow McLaren's Pato O'Ward from fourth to first in the starting line-up.

title: Kyle Kirkwood addresses title shot after Alex Palou leaves door open following Freedom 250
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Palou's disastrous showing in Washington, D.C. has left the door open for Kirkwood to pull off a shocking comeback in the points race.

title: Could big TV numbers draw IndyCar back to Washington, D.C.?
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: The Freedom 250 Grand Prix was billed as a special one-off event and may very well end up being one.  But there was clearly an appetite for the race, raising the question of whether IndyCar should return to the capital.
